notes.title: Post-Release Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
The work at the carrot factory never stops! Just one week after release, we’re back with a patch for Carrot Survivors full of bug fixes, performance improvements, and quality of life tweaks 🥕

Let’s dive into the highlights.

[b]Improved Performance[/b]

While the game runs fine on most machines, we found bugs causing performance issues even on high-end systems, especially late in runs. This update improves performance so things stay smooth—even in the craziest scenarios.

Our goal is to keep the game stable no matter how hectic things get! Please report any performance issues you encounter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44851586/12c825125d0738aac9080ccc062bca70b232a095.png[/img]
[b]Better Controller Support[/b]

Many players reported confusion with the game treating keyboard and controller as separate players. This also affected touchscreen support on the Steam Deck.

Now, the first available controller and the keyboard will both act as Player 1, making single-player much smoother.

If you were using keyboard and controller for co-op, don’t worry! You can restore the old behavior under Options > Advanced Settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44851586/6f0d29d97ae067ef5c7506edd248bbfd74e6484e.png[/img]

[b]Remote Play with Friends[/b]

Carrot Survivors has supported Remote Play Together since launch, but many players didn’t realize it was available. To help, we’ve added a Remote Play with Friends button to the main menu.

This opens your Steam friends menu so you can quickly invite people to join. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay#together]Learn more about Remote Play Together[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44851586/fceadd888cadedf6e8cab9e549ea8a5dabc0e9b4.png[/img]

[b]Full changelog[/b]

For the curious, here’s everything that changed:

[i]Game Balance:[/i]
- Reroll and Skip can now be used during boss chest pickups for better tactical choices.
- The bubblemancing weapon now damages bosses directly instead of bubbling them.
- You can now make slight movements while attempting the shotgun quest, preventing accidental movement from breaking the kill chain.

[i]Performance:[/i]
- Better performance when many experience pickups are on screen.
- Optimized projectile weapon performance.
- Fixed a serious performance bug affecting the Drift Essence weapon.

[i]Game Input:[/i]
- Overhauled input handling: both keyboard and the first controller now route to Player 1.

[i]User Interface:[/i]
- Added button icon prompts for world interactables.
- Added Remote Play with Friends option.
- Dash cooldown slider now fills up instead of emptying.
- Run timer now displays above nearby item markers.

[i]Settings:[/i]
- Added an Advanced Settings menu.
- Moved Import Demo Save Data under Advanced Settings.
- Added new options to erase save data, re-check Steam achievements, and set UI scale to 75%.
- Volume sliders now allow finer adjustments.

[i]Misc:[/i]
- Replaced the main menu Wishlist button with a Leave Feedback button linking to the Steam forums.
- Fixed typos in in-game dialogs.
- Removed some invisible wall bugs around the map.
- Improved Windows desktop icon resolution (no more blur!).

notes.title: 🥕 Carrot Survivors is Out! 🥕
notes.content:
Let the party begin! 💖 🥕 The carrot zombies are out of the bag and Carrot Corp needs [b]you[/b] to help end this mess!

With 19 playable characters, each packing unique weapons, tons of enemies, challenge levels, a packed open map, and a story sprinkled with humor—it’s grown into something way bigger than we first imagined. We’re super excited to finally share it all with you!

We're a small indie studio, and this was our first game, but we're extremely proud of it. If you enjoyed it, [b]leave a review[/b]! It means the world to us.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44851586/99fe800c23833cb7a2dc457b2825df1ec3bdd4ea.png[/img]

notes.content: Watch us play carrot survivors to celebrate the release!

notes.title: 🥕 Upcoming Release! 🥕
notes.content:
We made it to the finish line! After weeks of squashing bugs, small tweaks and lots of balancing, everything is ready for release 🎉

We're really excited to announce Carrot Survivors is releasing this Friday, April 25th @ 7PM CEST / 10 AM PDT

We hope to see you there!

notes.title: New Demo Version for the Steam Couch Co-Op Fest
notes.content:
🎺 We're here with some freshly baked Carrot Games news for you! 🎺

Development has been quite hectic for the past few months. After a good reception at Steam Next fest, we decided to invest some more time in the game for polish, content, and features. Whether you played our old demo or not, you're in for a treat, with the full release featuring:

[list]
[*] The [b]complete character roster[/b], with unique new weapons and challenges for each character
[*] [b]Achievements:[/b] Both Steam and in-game. Each achievement unlocks new content inside the game!
[*] [b]Final boss fight:[/b] If you want to beat the game, now you'll have to prove your worth against the final boss!
[*] Secret [b]endgame content[/b] and unlockable items
[/list]

And in preparation for the upcoming release, we are featuring a brand new demo in the Steam Couch Co-Op fest, starting tomorrow.

We really hope you enjoy it! 🥕
